newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's OSROK says passes on copper tender.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's OSROK says passes on copper tender.

text.p: South Korea's Office of Supply (OSROK) said on Thursday it passed on tenders for 2,550 tonnes copper cathode, due to high prices.
An OSROK official said it would re-invite the tender soon.
The official said the copper must be listed on the London Metal Exchange's deliverable brands of grade A.
Shipment of the passed tender was slated for December 31 and delivery by January 31 to the western port city of Inchon.
